hub.headline: LithTech Jupiter was Monolith's game engine and development system for Windows PCs.
hub.next: Write build notes for people who already own a lawful copy, without copying any engine files.
hub.what_it_was: Jupiter was a version of the LithTech Development System for Windows PCs, built with Visual C++ 6.0 against DirectX 8.1 and working with 3ds Max and Maya. An Internet Archive item preserves build 51, dated March 19, 2002, with a development guide that covers toolchain needs and component layout.
hub.what_survives: The Internet Archive item and the development guide are public, but the guide's legal notice reads copyright 1998 to 2002 LithTech, Inc., all rights reserved. The ltjs project maintains a fork, yet its source carries an in-tree all-rights-reserved notice and the claimed GPLv2 release has no primary source, so rights are unresolved.

name: LithTech Jupiter
summary: Public records now track the LithTech Jupiter build 51 archive item, development guide metadata, IA file fixity, and a rights-safe user-supplied build lane without mirroring engine files, game assets, or proprietary tools.
